title: SkillData v1
$comment: Locked in Phase 3.7 (authoritative prose: docs/skilldata_v1.md). Two layers: the captured human-motion BASE LAYER (session, calibration, imu_streams, segment_kinematics, phase_labels) is robot-independent and always present; the ROBOT-READY LAYER (retarget) is a derived view that maps the motion onto one or more target robot morphologies via inverse kinematics, and is optional.
description: AI-training-ready motor-capture record: one trial of one subject performing one motion class, captured by the 4-IMU arm sleeve. Carries the raw/fused human kinematics plus, optionally, the motion retargeted onto target robots.

session.description: Per-trial metadata. motion_class is a first-class field.

motion_class.description: Motion label, e.g. reach, lift, wrist_rotate, throw.

n_samples.description: Number of timesteps in every per-sample array.

calibration.description: Calibration coefficients applied to this capture (per calibration_protocol.md). May be empty for synthetic captures.

gyro_bias_dps.description: Per-sensor gyroscope bias (deg/s), keyed by sensor ID.

accel_scale.description: Per-sensor accelerometer scale factors, keyed by sensor ID.

inter_imu_alignment_quat.description: Per-sensor mounting-alignment quaternion [w,x,y,z] from the T-pose, keyed by sensor ID.

imu_streams.description: Raw + fused per-IMU time series, keyed by sensor ID (S0, S2, S4, S5). The 2-DOF synthetic source populates S2 and S4; S0/S5 arrive with the 3D model (3.2) and the hardware capture (Phase 9).

linear_accel_g.description: Accelerometer specific force [x,y,z] in units of g per sample.

quaternion.description: Fused orientation [w,x,y,z] per sample (added by the fusion stage).

saturation_flag.description: True where the gyro pinned at its full-scale range (D2 envelope).

segment_kinematics.description: Fused segment-level kinematics derived from relative IMU orientation. Robot-independent.

joint_angles_rad.description: Recovered joint angles over time, keyed by joint (shoulder from S0-S2, elbow from S2-S4, wrist from S4-S5). Each value is a per-sample array.

retarget.description: ROBOT-READY LAYER (optional, derived). The captured motion mapped onto one or more target robot morphologies via inverse kinematics. Keyed by robot id. Because the base layer is robot-independent, a new robot is added by re-running retargeting on the same record — no re-capture. Reference target = an open humanoid (Unitree G1/H1); Tesla Optimus is the named aspirational target the format accepts once a URDF exists.

urdf_ref.description: Path/URL/identifier of the URDF that defines this morphology.

link_lengths_m.description: Link lengths used for the IK, if applicable.

joint_trajectory_rad.description: Per-sample robot joint angles [n_samples x dof], radians.

target_position_m.description: The base-layer end-effector path the IK tracked, per sample (e.g. the wrist position).

reachable_flag.description: False where the target fell outside the robot workspace and was clamped.
